# Templates & Checklists

Ready‑to‑adapt starting points: checklists you can drop into a ticket, and
policy skeletons you can fill in. They turn the guidance in this knowledge base
into things you can actually *use*.

> ⚖️ **Important:** The **policy templates** (privacy policy, terms, cookie
> policy) are **skeletons, not finished legal documents.** They must be adapted
> to your actual practices and jurisdiction, and — for anything with real risk —
> reviewed by a qualified professional. A policy that doesn't match what you
> actually do can be worse than none. See
> [Legal & Compliance](../10-legal-and-compliance/README.md).

## Checklists (use freely)

**Broad gates:**
- **[Pre‑launch checklist](pre-launch-checklist.md)** — the gate before you go
  live, covering every discipline.
- **[Maintenance checklist](maintenance-checklist.md)** — the recurring
  weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual cadence.

**Deeper, single‑domain checklists** (run alongside the broad ones, for their
specific moment):
- **[Security hardening checklist](security-hardening-checklist.md)** — a
  security‑specific audit for launch **and** periodic review.
- **[SEO checklist](seo-checklist.md)** — crawl/index, on‑page, structured data,
  Search Console, and page experience; for launch and periodic SEO audits.
- **[Privacy & compliance checklist](privacy-compliance-checklist.md)** — the
  data‑protection obligations most sites have; for build time and annual review.
- **[Payments go‑live checklist](payments-go-live-checklist.md)** — before you
  take real money (Stripe‑oriented).
- **[Project handover & ownership checklist](project-handover-checklist.md)** —
  for handing a site over without leaving a "who owns/maintains it?" gap.

**Other templates:**
- **[Incident report template](incident-report-template.md)** — structure for
  documenting and learning from incidents.
- **[Accessibility statement template](accessibility-statement-template.md)** —
  a public statement of your accessibility commitment and conformance.

## Policy skeletons (adapt + get review)

- **[Privacy policy template](privacy-policy-template.md)**
- **[Terms of Service template](terms-of-service-template.md)**
- **[Cookie policy template](cookie-policy-template.md)**

## How to use these

1. **Copy** the file (or its content) into your project.
2. **Fill in** every `[BRACKETED PLACEHOLDER]`.
3. **Delete** anything that doesn't apply to you; **add** anything specific to
   your situation.
4. For policies, **verify it matches your real practices** and **get
   professional review.**
5. **Date** it and keep it updated as things change (see the
   [maintenance plan](../09-maintenance/maintenance-plan.md)).

> Placeholders look like `[COMPANY NAME]`, `[EMAIL]`, `[JURISDICTION]`. Search
> for `[` to make sure you've filled them all in.
